description: Estimate what a charge costs in EUR at public chargers in Lithuania, per charging network, at each network's typical (median) ad hoc price incl. VAT. Give either `kwh` (energy to add) or `car_battery_kwh` with `from_pct` and `to_pct`. Without `operator` returns the cheapest networks, the most expensive one and the national typical price. Excludes per-minute or session fees, which `extra_fees: true` flags.

car_battery_kwh.description: Usable battery capacity, kWh, e.g. 58 for a VW ID.3 Pro.

from_pct.description: State of charge at the start, %. Default 20.

kwh.description: Energy to add, kWh. Alternative to car_battery_kwh.

operator.description: Charging network name or slug, to price one network only.

power_class.description: Price class: "ac" = AC charging (usually up to 22 kW), "dc" = DC fast charging under 150 kW, "hpc" = high-power DC at 150 kW or more.

to_pct.description: State of charge at the end, %. Default 80.

name: charging_cost
title: EV charging cost calculator
